title: Brown Mountain Beach Resort

services.name: Paddle Sports and Tubing
services.desc: All Paddlesport and Tubes are included with your stay! Tube trips excluded *Please note, we do have life jackets for any who need it. River Tubing is a well known past time here on the creek! While tubing on our mile stretch of private waters is included during your stay, tubing the gorge with your group/family can elevate your stay and bring even more adventure. Our trolley will take you up Wilson Creek Gorge so you can experience a class III rapid and tube down to the resort. It is a 30 minute tube trip full of twists, turns and a bit of relaxation, the trolley will give unlimited trips for three hours. $15 per person. Please inquire with our concierge here Surrounded deep in the beauty
